svg.text: Pictures: blue/red = components; green arrows = faces where the new bonds form (both down = s, one up + one down = a).
Count (4q+2)s components and (4r)a components; an odd total means thermally allowed.
Electron counts, not atom counts: allyl cation and 1,3-dipole are 3-atom components with 2 and 4 electrons. Electrocyclic rows (L17) show a (4r)a count.
